decoded.meaning: FWD{ op=REPLY, dst=/reply-ep, src=<path label 0:1>/sensor/temp, kind=RESULT, VALUE u32=1234 } - a reply as a MINTING forwarder relays it (RFC-0027 6.1). The hop's own local part, the three-segment mount run `net/uplink/b`, is spelled as one 7-byte path-label element instead of the 13 bytes of string it stands for.
decoded.note: The label is the RFC-0018 escape record `00 16 04 <u32 LE>`, index 0 at generation 1 (RFC-0027 5.3.2, amendment 5). One label stands for the hop's WHOLE mount run, never one segment (amendment 6). A hop that does not mint relays this reply with its src untouched and is fully conformant (6.3). The `kind` child is REQUIRED on every REPLY (RFC-0004 B) and is relayed untouched: a mint rewrites `src` and nothing else.
